title: PCSO Lotto Results:No winners of Grand Lotto P265M and Megalotto P105M prizes in Oct.12 draws

blocks.text: Winners remained elusive for the major jackpot draws on October 12, where the Grand Lotto 6/55 prize is now over P265 million while that of Megalotto 6/45 has topped P105 million, the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PCSO) announced on Monday.
No bettor selected the winning combination of 05-41-23-28-20-51 for the Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot that now stands at P265,501,153.97.

According to the PCSO, the odds of winning the Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot are exactly 1 in 28,989,675. This means that for every single ticket combination a bettor buy, their chance of hitting all six numbers correctly is approximately 0.00000345%.
The most recent Grand Lotto 6/55 jackpot winner was a lone bettor from Morong, Bataan, who won ₱115,358,791.87 on May 20, 2026.
It was the same result for Megalotto 6/45 after no bettor took home the P105,814,037.52 windfall whose correct numbers of 03-22-44-13-39-11 were left unplayed.
